visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation begins in a brightly lit bathroom with a cartoon man happily washing his hair under a showerhead. He is covered in white soap suds, smiling with his eyes closed as water pours down. The background features a grey tiled wall and a dark, rectangular window frame. (2) The man begins to wash his face, using both hands to scrub with soap. His eyes are tightly shut, and his face is partially obscured by his hands and foam as the water continues to fall steadily. (3) In a sudden transition, a terrifying figure with long, straight black hair and a pale, heavily shadowed face appears directly in front of the man, replacing his hands. The lighting dims significantly, creating a dark and oppressive atmosphere. (4) The man abruptly pulls his hands away, looking wide-eyed and terrified with large sweat drops on his forehead. He frantically scans the room as the scary figure disappears, leaving him alone and visibly shaken in the bathroom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with the continuous white noise of water spraying from a showerhead onto a hard surface. The sound is steady and rhythmic, suggesting a confined indoor space. There is no background music or vocal content in this initial phase. (2) A sudden, high-intensity cinematic horror stinger interrupts the steady water sound. This stinger consists of a sharp, loud percussive impact followed by an eerie, dissonant synthesizer drone. The abrupt shift in volume and texture creates a feeling of immediate dread and jump-scare intensity. (3) The water sound returns to the foreground as the metallic resonance of the stinger slowly fades. The track concludes with the reappearance of the steady splashing water, maintaining a clean studio-quality recording throughout the short loop.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a relatable and humorous animated scenario to illustrate the sudden irrational fear of ghosts that can occur when showering alone late at night during the Ghost Month.
